days.title: Ochiai cobblestones to Nakatsugawa

items.text: TODO: save the Nakatsugawa city Nakasendo trail map (Nakatsugawa to Tsumago brochure) offline before setting off
Before setting off: wander Magome-juku's sloping street and the Toson Memorial Museum (former honjin, writer Shimazaki Toson); buy water and a snack
Hike Magome-juku to Nakatsugawa (~9 km, a casual 4 h; follow Nakasendo signs): Magome Castle ruins, then up and down the Jikkoku Pass; steep, take the descent slowly
Ochiai Cobblestone Path (~840 m through bamboo and woodland; ~70 m is original paving, slippery when damp)
Cross Shimogeta Bridge (Hiroshige print) into Ochiai-juku; see the honjin's gate, building and garden from outside (open Sundays only)
Continue to Nakatsugawa-juku past markers and shrines; the trail crosses Route 19 several times, follow the Nakasendo signs
Nakatsugawa-juku Honmachi merchant streets (10 min walk from JR Nakatsugawa station): sake shops, confectioners; Nakasendo Historical Museum if open
Kurikinton chestnut sweets: Nakatsugawa is its birthplace and late October is in season; shop hours vary
Check in at hatago STAY Shinmachi
Hida beef dinner

notes: Route: Magome Chaya, Magome-juku, Magome Castle site, Ochiai Cobblestone Path, Ochiai-juku, Nakatsugawa-juku, hatago STAY Shinmachi.
Start early to leave daylight for sightseeing and delays.
Shoes with good grip and a light rain layer; in the wet, slow down on the cobbles rather than keep pace.
Carry water and a snack; don't count on open shops on rural stretches.
Check the day's weather and trail conditions before setting out.

days.title: Trains to Nara and the deer park

items.text: Leave hatago STAY Shinmachi; 7 min walk to Nakatsugawa station
JR Chuo Main Line Section Rapid, Nakatsugawa to Nagoya, direct, arrive 11:37 (¥1,340)
Option A (AONIYOSHI, arrive earlier): Nozomi 25 Nagoya 12:10 to Kyoto 12:44 (¥6,660); AONIYOSHI Kyoto 12:55 to Kintetsu-Nara 13:28; walk 1.1 km to the hotel, about 13:43
Option B (Miyakoji, simpler): Nozomi 27 Nagoya 12:49 to Kyoto 13:23; Miyakoji Rapid 619 Kyoto 13:34 (platform 10) to JR Nara 14:21, direct, next to the hotel
Leave bags or check in; onsen before or after Nara Park
Nara Park and the deer; go soon after settling in, sunset about 17:07
Dinner at Kikuoka Kampo or around Sanjo-dori

notes: Night 1 of 4 in Nara.
Book ahead when we arrive in Tokyo: AONIYOSHI needs a reserved seat and a limited-express ticket.
Option A: 11 min transfer at Kyoto from JR to Kintetsu; have Kintetsu tickets ready and go straight there. 33 min at Nagoya.
Option B: about 1 h 12 min wait at Nagoya; arrives JR Nara next to the hotel, close to the original 14:30 plan.
Ask the hotel about leaving bags before check-in.
